summary: Prudential plc filed a 6-K reporting ongoing on-market share buy-backs executed through JP Morgan Securities plc under a mandate announced 6 January 2026. Between 10-14 August 2026, Prudential repurchased ~1.87 million ordinary shares at prices from 10.055 to 10.48 GBP per share. Shares are to be cancelled, reducing share count to 2,498,974,731. Cumulative program purchases reached 54,972,238 shares at a weighted average price of 10.87 GBP. The buy-back is an on-exchange transaction under LSE and HKEX rules, returning capital to shareholders.
